services.name: Yoga on the Lawn
services.desc: Join us for a time of reflection and exercise on our beautiful lawn overlooking Lake Winnebago. This season, we’re pleased to offer both morning and evening sessions, giving you more opportunities to enjoy a harmonious connection of mind and body while taking in the grandeur of the museum’s back lawn. After class, we invite you to visit our galleries. This is a wonderful class in a gorgeous and serene setting, perfect for yoga practitioners of every level. Don’t forget your mat! Yoga on the Lawn is hosted Wednesday mornings, 8am-9am and Thursday evenings, 5:30pm-6:30pm. Sessions will run from June 17th to September

services.name: Classes
services.desc: Adult classes at Bergstrom-Mahler Museum of Glass are designed for ages 16 and older and are taught by Glass Studio staff and professional artists. Classes cover a variety of techniques, including fusing, flameworking, and hot glass, and are typically 3 hours long with time for both instruction and creating your own project. For safety and focus, individuals under 16 are not permitted in adult classes unless approved in advance by the Glass Studio. - More than 14 days before class: Full refund or full-value gift certificate. - 7-14 days before class: Gift certificate minus a $10 materials fee, or transfer your spot to another person. - Less than 7 days before class: No refunds or credits;

services.name: Past Exhibits
services.desc: William Manson was born in the small town of Wick, Caithness in the far north of Scotland. Growing up, he watched his father create extraordinary works of art from glass. At the age of 14, William tried his hand at lampworking and paperweight-making for the first time. Shatter the Ordinary explores the evolution of the artist’s work while paying tribute to the Scottish paperweight-making tradition. Born in 1955, Drew Ebelhare is widely celebrated for his detailed millefiori paperweights.
